headline: Subscriber surge and record margin; guidance raised again

drivers.explanation: Mobility and broadband service revenue grew 2.9% y/y, partly offset by a 9.0% drop in equipment revenue on fewer upgrades and reduced device subsidies.
Release credits operational efficiency; Adjusted EBITDA margin widened from 37.8% to 40.2% y/y.
Customer-first offers and loyalty program over heavy subsidies; promotional cost of acquisition fell 41% y/y and churn improved 4 bps to 0.94%.
Management frames the quarter as one year into a multi-year transformation, and raised full-year guidance for the third consecutive quarter.

summary_short: Verizon reported Q3 revenue of $34.3B (+1.5% y/y) and Adjusted EPS of $1.31 (+8.3% y/y), with 406k postpaid phone net adds and free cash flow of $7.8B.
summary_long: Service growth in mobility and broadband (+2.9% y/y) offset a 9.0% equipment revenue decline. Adjusted EBITDA margin hit 40.2% from 37.8%. Full-year 2026 guidance was raised: Adjusted EPS $5.04-$5.06, postpaid phone net adds 1.1-1.2 million, free cash flow growth approaching 12%. Net unsecured debt was $123.7B (2.3x Adjusted EBITDA) versus $128.7B at Q2. Nine-month capital returned was $12.8B, including $4.0B of buybacks.
confidence_notes: Adjusted EPS, Adjusted EBITDA, free cash flow and net unsecured debt are non-GAAP measures as defined by the company.
